facts.text: The Converse Guarantee promises full-time undergraduate students graduation in four years or remaining degree classes tuition-free, as well as full-time employment or graduate school enrollment within six months or a full tuition-free return year.

sources.title: Converse At a Glance
sources.quote: We guarantee all students will be employed full-time or enrolled in graduate school within six months of graduation, or be eligible to return for a full year tuition-free*.
